correctness.rationale: Even inputs are an isometric permutation because (F(a)-F(b))/(a-b) is 1 mod 4. It remains 1 mod 4 for each iterate; applying the iterate to a point displaced by delta produces 2delta times an odd unit, yielding exactly nu_2(F^{2^t}(x)-x)=3r+t. In each odd congruence class mod 8 the difference valuation grows by exactly 2, so mapping to its mod-32 target class is exactly four-to-one; two source classes give eight odd predecessors. Counting completes the cycles and indegrees. Exhaustive executable verification covers levels 5..16 without being substituted for the infinite proof.
